outcome: Liver function test (TSB, AST, ALT, ALP, total protein, albumin)
cohort: Neonates with gestational age >35 weeks, weighing >1.8 kg, and Apgar score <7 at 1 minute, admitted to a newborn unit of a tertiary care hospital in West Bengal, India.
finding: Liver enzymes (except total protein and albumin) showed a significant rise on days 1 and 3 with increasing severity of asphyxia, and Thompson and Apgar scores correlated with perinatal asphyxia-related hepatic injury.
